{{- /* Recursive printer for sections */ -}}
{{- define "llms_print_section" -}}
{{- $section := .section -}}
{{- $depth := .depth -}}
{{- if or (gt (len $section.RegularPages) 0) (gt (len $section.Sections) 0) -}}
{{- $hashes := strings.Repeat (add $depth 1) "#" }}

{{ printf "%s %s" $hashes $section.Title }}

{{- /* Pages in this section */ -}}
{{- range $p := $section.RegularPages }}
  {{- if and (not $p.Params.searchHidden) (ne $p.Layout `archives`) (ne $p.Layout `search`) }}
- [{{ $p.Title }}]({{ with $p.OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ .Permalink }}{{ else }}{{ $p.Permalink }}{{ end }})
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- /* Recurse into subsections */ -}}
{{- range $s := $section.Sections -}}
{{- template "llms_print_section" (dict "section" $s "depth" (add $depth 1)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- /*
  Overrides the theme's llms.txt (themes/PaperMod/layouts/_default/llms.txt)
  to link each page's plain-Markdown alternate (its "markdown" output format,
  e.g. /2024/02/my-post/index.md) rather than the HTML page, since an
  llms.txt index exists specifically to hand LLM readers structured content
  cheaply. Falls back to the regular permalink for any page kind that
  doesn't have a markdown output (page = ["HTML", "markdown"] in hugo.toml
  covers ordinary pages/posts, so in practice this only matters if that
  ever changes).

  The URL is computed inline inside the "- [...]" line (not as a preceding
  {{ $url := ... }} statement) deliberately: an earlier version put it on
  its own trimmed line above, and its leading {{- trim marker ate the
  newline that used to separate each list entry, collapsing the whole
  output onto one line. Keeping it inline leaves the original template's
  newline handling completely undisturbed.
*/ -}}

{{- /* Main template starts here */ -}}
# {{ site.Title }}

{{- /* Pages not in any section */ -}}
{{- $orphans := where site.RegularPages "Section" "" -}}
{{ if gt (len $orphans) 0 }}

{{- range $p := $orphans -}}
  {{ if and (not $p.Params.searchHidden) (ne $p.Layout `archives`) (ne $p.Layout `search`) (not $p.IsHome) }}
- [{{ $p.Title }}]({{ with $p.OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ .Permalink }}{{ else }}{{ $p.Permalink }}{{ end }})
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- end -}}

{{- range site.Sections -}}
{{- template "llms_print_section" (dict "section" . "depth" 1) -}}
{{- end }}
